events.title: Name Change
events.summary: Hi everyone, I have changed the name of the game from Coup d'Koala to Coup de Koala. This is a very minor change but technically grammatically correct since the grammatical preposition "d'" from the French phrase "coup d'etat" is only shortened from the full spelling "de" when placed before a vowel. When placed before a consonant, "de" must be used.Best,Victor L.
